base_prompt:
Redraw reference image 1 as one square full-bleed game card illustration. Closely preserve its recognizable subject, camera angle, composition, gesture and motion. Fill the curved black card-crop corners with the surrounding background. No text, card frame, UI, numbers or watermark.
Use BOLD THICK hand-drawn ink outlines with natural stroke variation, simple loosely hand-painted shapes, broad hard-edged shadows and a muted slate/olive/taupe palette, with limited effect accents appropriate to the original. MUCH SIMPLER than reference 2: few essential details, sparse abstract dashes and dots for texture; NO dense hair strands, tiny rivets, scratches, elaborate crack networks, polished realism or meticulous rendering.
Reference 2 is ONLY the protagonist identity: lean male kiln worker, swept-back dark shoulder-length hair, tan sleeveless workshirt, slate apron, iron wristguards, pale angular ceramic 3/4 mask with pointed brows and narrow black eye slits, chipped lower edge. Right hand natural skin; left hand pale ceramic. Do not import its pose, background or extra equipment. Only show character parts appropriate to image 1.
Any protagonist sword becomes a functional single-bladed grey iron woodcutting axe with wooden handle, connected socket/head/short poll. Correct anatomy, flowing wrists, plausible grip and blade-leading motion; no floating blades or wooden arms. Do not add a weapon where the original has none. No gore.

cards.name: 战斗专注
cards.subject: Keep the giant cropped hand entering upper right holding a thin chain with a round heavy pendulum hanging toward lower center. Dark purple spiral concentric background and three tiny orange figures. Strong hypnosis icon. No hero body or axe.

cards.name: 以血还血
cards.subject: Preserve the two facing figures leaning into reciprocal attacks, hero at left and blue hooded enemy at right. Adapt the two crossing swords to two compact axes, with convincing hands and edge-first opposing chops. Clear two silhouettes, tiny flat red impact marks, no wounds or gore.
cards.edit_prompt: Precise local edit of image 1. User correction: the BLUE HOODED WIZARD ON THE RIGHT must wield a MAGIC STAFF, NOT AN AXE. Replace only the weapon gripped by the wizard's green hand at center-right: remove its metal axe head entirely and replace its shaft with a longer dark wooden wizard staff, capped by a simple crooked fork holding a small muted violet magical stone. The staff can angle down-right through the same grip and extend up-left across the exchange; fingers wrap naturally around the staff. Preserve the LEFT masked warrior and his SINGLE iron axe exactly, keep both character poses, red background, crop and lighting. Exactly one axe total, belonging to left warrior; one staff belongs to right wizard. Keep square composition and existing coarse hand-drawn style, fairly thick irregular ink outlines, simple broad color/shadow shapes, sparse abstract dashes/dots. Do not add detail or polished rendering. No text, UI or border.

cards.name: 放血
cards.subject: Keep palm facing viewer, fingers naturally bent, forearm rising from bottom right. A stream of stylized red-orange magic pours from palm downward into curling fiery shapes on dark blue ground. Abstract dots for droplets, no wound.

cards.name: 燃烧契约
cards.subject: Keep close-up of two hands firmly shaking at center, arms entering from upper left and upper right, a loose orange flame ring encircling the handshake. Right opposing arm is dark reddish demonic; simplify bumps. Correct five-finger clasp silhouette, muted slate background.

cards.name: 残杀
cards.subject: Preserve the heaped triangular composition of defeated fantasy monsters and broken armor: large green reptile head/eye lower right, steel fragments, yellow coiling shapes and red debris. Use non-graphic stylized collapsed creature shapes, no exposed organs. Big bold chunky shapes, very sparse details.

cards.name: 炽心
cards.subject: Preserve small black front-facing human silhouette at center within an enormous swirling amber/red flame wreath and bright pale core. A few black debris dots, no detailed body or weapon; flame shapes dominate.

cards.name: 黑暗之拥
cards.subject: Preserve tight crop of a warrior hunched at upper right, surrounded/embraced by purple-black shadow arms: one clawed hand rests over shoulder, another wraps lower chest. Large dark negative space at left with purple ribbons. Replace gold helmet with pale kiln mask, tan/slate outfit. Hands clearly part of shadow entity.

cards.name: 缴械
cards.subject: Preserve hero cropped over-shoulder at extreme left watching a blue-hooded enemy at center-right raise both empty hands overhead, fingers open. Red concentric magical rings behind enemy. A weapon drops diagonally lower-left; adapt it to ONE intact falling woodcutting axe. Clear disarmed/surrender gesture, no extra arms.
cards.edit_prompt: Precise local edit: image1 is target, image2 original Slay the Spire art is ONLY composition/cropping guidance. Remove foreground hero's visible LOWER ARM, wristguard and holding hand in the bottom-left. Match original image2 structure: only a tight slice of hero head/hair/shoulder along extreme LEFT edge; the weapon enters separately from BELOW the bottom-left edge, with its wielder's hand and forearm completely OUTSIDE THE FRAME. Keep the AXE head in lower-center and a short shaft segment entering from bottom-left; NO hand/forearm attached inside picture. Repaint removed forearm/hand area as purple background/red ring continuation. Preserve blue-hooded enemy's TWO RAISED ARMS AND HANDS unchanged, preserve mask, red rings, colors, axe design. User's 'do not expose forearm' refers ONLY to foreground weapon holder, not surrendering enemy. Keep square composition and existing coarse hand-drawn style, fairly thick irregular ink outlines, simple broad color/shadow shapes, sparse abstract dashes/dots. Do not add detail or polished rendering. No text, UI or border.

cards.name: 飞身踢
cards.subject: Preserve nearly black silhouette of attacker flying horizontally from upper-left to right, fully extended kicking leg strikes smaller blue figure's face at right; trailing leg bent at knee. Huge angular yellow impact star on dark muted crimson radial ground. Keep silhouettes simple, leg joint continuity and ONE striking foot, no weapon.

cards.name: 双持
cards.subject: Preserve standing 3/4 hero facing left, body near right center, arms lowered apart holding TWO separate glowing weapons. Replace each curved sword with an intact compact SINGLE-BLADED AXE: left foreground axe clearly large by perspective, right receding axe smaller. Hands grip shafts below heads, never cutting edges. Cool teal/navy radial background; pale glow around axe edges.
cards.refinement_prompt: Edit reference1. KEEP composition, two axes, poses, background, glow and loose coarse hand-painted ink style. Replace ONLY hero character identity, using reference2: REMOVE gold full-face helmet and gold shoulder pauldrons entirely. Add pale ivory angular ceramic 3/4 mask with pointed brow corners, narrow black slits, chipped lower edge exposing lower face; dark shoulder-length hair. Tan sleeveless kiln workshirt, brown straps, slate split apron, olive trousers, iron wristguards. His left hand (small hand at viewer right) must be PALE CERAMIC; right hand natural tan. Keep both intact axes, easy natural wrist grips. Simplify all detail into bold rough lines and flat shadows, no meticulous texture. Square full bleed, no text.

cards.name: 巩固
cards.subject: Preserve close-up defensive barricade filling lower 3/4: stacked soft sandbags behind thick horizontal wooden boards, large sacks in lower corners; bright orange upper sky and blue-purple abstract falling attack streaks. NO character or weapon. Three or four big burlap shapes with sparse dots instead of dense fabric weave.

cards.name: 进化
cards.subject: Preserve three green slime creatures increasing in size from lower-left small to center medium to upper-right giant, with frightened black cutout eyes/mouths and a few dangling drips; giant wears tiny tilted dark hat. Dark violet broad curved streak background. Chunky loose outline, only sparse green dots, not detailed slime texture.

cards.name: 无惧疼痛
cards.subject: Preserve frontal waist-up warrior at center with both clenched fists lifted beside head, elbows bent down/out, golden protective outline; broken axe heads and wood shafts bounce away with sparse angular yellow sparks. IMPORTANT replace the original GOLD FULL HELMET and gold shoulder armor with protagonist's PALE CERAMIC ANGULAR partial mask, dark swept hair, tan sleeveless workshirt and iron wristguards. No large golden pauldrons. No held weapon.

cards.name: 火焰吐息
cards.subject: Preserve extreme close crop of creature/warrior open mouth at upper right breathing huge curling orange/yellow fire blast diagonally toward lower left, fire fills most picture. Adapt face to kiln protagonist's exposed mouth below angular pale broken mask edge, natural teeth indicated as few simple shapes. Black hair framing right, no purple monstrous lips or giant fangs.

cards.name: 窑壁
cards.subject: Preserve small hero fullbody silhouette at lower left facing RIGHT, forward arm outstretched with open palm toward towering curved wall of flame across right 2/3. Other hand near torso, firm staggered feet. Fire is single broad orange crescent with gold rim and few embers. Tiny pale ceramic mask accent; NO axe.

cards.name: 挡钳
cards.subject: Preserve centered empty spectral armor hovering in blue flame, arms loosely hanging, luminous pale lower legs and dark chest/hand voids, encircled by dark smoke curls. Adapt helmet silhouette to pointed angular ceramic mask rather than horned samurai helmet; armor simplified ghostly iron wristguards and apron-like breastplate. No visible living person, no weapon.

cards.name: 御血术
cards.subject: Preserve giant splayed hand/forearm in lower-left foreground casting branching vermilion magic toward small green victim flung backward at upper right with arms open. Red graphic starburst obscures center of victim, no wounds/gore. Exactly five clear fingers. Dark muted maroon/slate background with sparse branching lines.

cards.name: 地狱之刃
cards.subject: Preserve solitary infernal weapon standing vertically embedded in cracked dark volcanic rock below center, orange molten drips running down rock and broad orange rays on burgundy. REPLACE SWORD COMPLETELY with a single-bladed woodcutting AXE: short wrapped wooden handle uppermost, broad iron axe head embedded edge-first at bottom, one small abstract skull insignia on head, bright red-orange cutting edge. NOT sword-shaped, no sword crossguard, no hand/person.
cards.refinement_prompt: Edit reference1. Keep molten rock, colors, orange rays and small skull emblem, but REPLACE malformed cleaver-like weapon with a mechanically correct SINGLE-BLADED WOODCUTTING AXE. Reference2 shows correct axe construction: wood handle enters cylindrical socket of CROSSWISE iron head, blade extends perpendicular to handle, flat short poll opposite. In edited scene axe is tilted diagonally: long wood handle extends to UPPER RIGHT; connected grey iron head at LOWER LEFT, broad crescent cutting edge bites into rock, opposite flat poll visible. Small skull emblem on broad metal head, molten orange lip on blade. No sword crossguard, no blade extending as straight continuation of handle. Thick rough ink, large simple flat color shapes, sparse dots/dashes only, no fine scratches. No person/text/border.

cards.name: 炉怒
cards.subject: Preserve a SINGLE floating weapon diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right head, engulfed in loose orange flames on dark slate background with broad curved smoke shapes. REPLACE sword with practical woodcutting AXE: long brown shaft aligned lower-left to upper-right, iron head mounted CROSSWISE through a clear socket at upper-right, broad cutting edge fans to upper-left, short flat poll opposite. No crossguard or sword blade. Only a few simple flame tongues.

cards.name: 泼水
cards.subject: Preserve extremely low viewpoint BETWEEN protagonist's dark booted legs in foreground left and right, framing TWO cowering green slime enemies center distance. Giant dark leg silhouettes, anxious slimes with angular eyes and sparse drops. No protagonist face, no added weapon or water container; preserve original intimidation topic even though local card name differs.

cards.name: 定型
cards.subject: Preserve fullbody standing figure with wide planted legs and both bent arms raising clenched fists, elbows out, cool BLUE radial backdrop and gold aura rim. Replace gold full helmet with PALE CERAMIC pointed partial mask and dark hair; body undergoing metallic hardening expressed as broad silver-grey facets over tan workshirt/slate apron, iron wristguards, no ornate plate armor or gold pauldrons. Character's left fist viewer-right distinctly pale ceramic.

cards.name: 硬撑
cards.subject: Preserve waist-up hunched hero facing viewer, head bowed, red glowing impact on upper-left chest (viewer-right), BOTH hands holding one weapon low across front. Convert sword to ONE axe held with hands spaced along continuous wooden handle, axe head at far LEFT foreground, cutting edge facing outward left. Blue radial background, gold rimlight. PALE CERAMIC mask and dark hair, tan workshirt, iron wristguards, no gold helmet/pauldrons. Red is abstract glow, no wound.

cards.name: 连续拳
cards.subject: Preserve abstract rushing yellow-green fists from left at several heights toward a simple orange humanoid silhouette at right. Largest fist in left-middle foreground, a lower fist and smaller upper distant fists with broad yellow motion trails. Impact zigzags on target. Bold graphic shapes, no hero face/body, treat repeated fists as motion echoes rather than extra anatomical limbs.

cards.name: 狂怒
cards.subject: Preserve extreme frontal crop of enraged open mouth and lower face filling image, orange-red angular shout bolts bursting toward lower corners over dark red rays. Top edge shows only protagonist's PALE broken ceramic mask's tapered lower rim with glimpse of tan face; don't import original gold helmet or green skin. Simple teeth indicated as grouped white shapes, open dark mouth. Thick loose strokes, no fine saliva or facial pores.

cards.name: 暴走
cards.subject: Preserve first-person close-up hands in lower-left swinging one huge weapon across screen toward a crowd of small enemy silhouettes along upper-left/back. Broad gold-white sweep arc stretches to upper-right. Replace sword with intact AXE: hands grip continuous wood shaft extending diagonally to right, steel head at far right leading cutting-edge first, blade crosswise to shaft. Hero natural right and pale ceramic left hand. The motion arc is light, not a second blade. Dark red background, few debris shapes.

cards.name: 无谋冲锋
cards.subject: Preserve side-view hero leaping/changing from left toward smaller red horned enemy at right, knees bent backward, BOTH arms raised overhead gripping one weapon ready to chop. Replace overhead sword with one AXE, head clearly above/in front of hands and blade oriented down toward enemy; white-gold trailing arc. Enemy extends thin bright magical projectile leftward. Keep hero mostly dark silhouette with tiny pale mask and tan accents, broad red-purple background.

cards.name: 撕裂
cards.subject: Preserve centered waist-up front-facing hero flexing both arms overhead with clenched fists, huge vertical red-orange flame column rises behind. Replace GOLD FULL HELMET with pale angular ceramic partial mask and dark hair, tan sleeveless shirt, slate apron and iron wristguards. Protagonist left fist (viewer right) distinctly pale ceramic, right fist skin. No weapons or wounds, simple flame shapes.

cards.name: 灼热攻击
cards.subject: Preserve close first-person weapon swing from bottom-left through center toward right, brilliant yellow-orange broad fiery arc and several separated abstract flame shapes against deep blue-purple. Replace sword with one clearly readable single-blade AXE held by hand lower-left, shaft runs toward center, solid iron axe head at center-right with cutting edge leading right; trailing flame bends LEFT back toward hand. Do not turn axe into long sword or disconnected fire blade.

cards.name: 重振精神
cards.subject: Preserve close waist-up hero bent forward preparing weapon at center-right, one hand high and one hand low, blue ground with yellow rays from low contact point. Adapt original sword-drawing gesture into purposeful two-handed REGRIP of a VERTICAL WOODCUTTING AXE: top hand grips wooden handle just below crosswise axe head, bottom hand closes near handle butt, yellow star at bottom hand. No sheath/sword/crossguard. Pale angular ceramic mask, dark hair, tan workshirt, iron wristguards, left hand pale ceramic. Anatomically relaxed wrists.

cards.name: 盛怒
cards.subject: Preserve extreme symmetric frontal eye-area close-up, blazing RED eyes at left/right sending broad orange rays outward, nose ridge centered, very dark red ground. Adapt to protagonist: two narrow black eye SLITS cut in PALE CERAMIC angular mask; red fury light fills slits with bright tiny centers, no round human eyeballs exposed. Bold thick loose outlines, few planar mask shadows, no dense cracks or text.

cards.name: 哨卫
cards.subject: Preserve extreme close view of ONE large angled kite shield taking two bright white-yellow impacts along left edge, shield occupies almost entire right/center, diagonal gold rays and dark blue-violet smoke behind. Grey iron rim and muted olive pale ceramic central panel, a few chips around edges, only sparse crack marks. No character/weapon/text. Big geometric shape and two readable impact stars.

cards.name: 断魂斩
cards.subject: Preserve abstract RED humanoid at center with arms spread, cyan flame-like SOUL peeling upward and out of torso along a diagonal weapon strike, dark red-purple background. Replace sword with ONE AXE on same upper-right to lower-left diagonal: wooden handle at upper-right, crosswise connected iron axe head passing near lower-left torso, pale cutting-edge flash; no impalement/sword blade or gore. Spirit silhouette follows the original cyan sweep. No detailed hero face.

cards.name: 震荡波
cards.subject: Preserve completely abstract expanding CYAN shockwave: broad jagged curved rings sweeping from lower-left across center toward upper-right, dark blue/violet negative space between. Crisp large angular energy bands, minimal sparse hand-drawn accent lines. NO person, weapon, text, card frame or extra symbols.

cards.name: 观察弱点
cards.subject: Preserve fullbody golden/iron mechanical sentinel in center, thin angular limbs with three weak joints highlighted orange at both shoulders and lower-left ankle. Three rough black circular callouts around those weak joints, but REMOVE ALL numeric labels/text and their black label rectangles. Cool blue vertical light streaks background. Simple large segmented metal shapes, eyes two dim green dots, sparse abstract marks.

cards.name: 上勾拳
cards.subject: Preserve extreme close-up of ONE clenched fist raised upward, wrist and forearm enter lower center, huge orange flames curl around left and over knuckles. Correct compact fist with thumb folded over fingers, natural wrist; iron wristguard with two broad dark bands, natural skin fist. Dark muted burgundy background; no hero face, weapon or text, a few embers only.

cards.name: 卷灰
cards.subject: Preserve rear 3/4 view hero spinning with legs apart, both arms high and across body, huge white-gold sweeping circular attack arcs wrapping across lower foreground and upper-right. Replace sword with ONE AXE held by both hands at upper-right, connected crosswise grey head, wood handle gripped below socket; bright blade edge at leading rightmost end, arcs trail behind. Dark shoulder-length hair swept along spin, tan workshirt/slate apron and pale mask only in small profile. Correct planted stance and hands, dark red ground, NO additional weapons.
cards.edit_prompt: Precise local edit of image1. Fix ONLY AXE HEAD orientation at UPPER RIGHT so sharp cutting edge LEADS the existing upward curling golden swing trail. Current broad blade hangs BELOW wooden shaft, backwards to swing: FLIP metal head about its shaft/socket so BROAD BLADE PROJECTS ABOVE THE SHAFT instead; bright sharpened curved edge faces UPWARD along the leading top end of the ascending arc. Short flat blunt poll is below/opposite. Keep socket at SAME position, continuous same wooden handle, both same hand grips, hero pose, head, clothes, feet, red background and sweeping gold arcs. Give small clearance to top edge so whole head reads. Gold motion trail must terminate behind blade's trailing underside, never ahead of its cutting edge. ONE connected conventional single-bladed woodcutting axe, no double axe, no floating metal. Keep square composition and existing coarse hand-drawn style, fairly thick irregular ink outlines, simple broad color/shadow shapes, sparse abstract dashes/dots. Do not add detail or polished rendering. No text, UI or border.
